usage: Square Instagram Flavors Highlight cover alternatives, designed for a centered circular crop.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / brand highlight cover.
Create one polished square Instagram Story Highlight cover for HAPPY SPOON's "Flavors" collection, 1080x1080, designed to read instantly as a small circular profile highlight thumbnail.
Input image 1: Happy Spoon's existing social avatar, authoritative brand palette and smiling-face reference. Input image 2: competitor Instagram profile screenshot, reference ONLY for the simplicity and readability of the small circular highlight icons, not its branding, exact artwork, lettering, or colors.
Design a warm cream square canvas. A bold inset circular border made of five equal broad segments in coral red #ef4c3c, bright blue #1497ec, caramel gold #f39c1e, mint green #4fc690, and purple #8740cf, with tiny cream gaps, echoing the supplied avatar. Keep entire ring comfortably inside a centered circular crop, ring outer diameter 88% of image width.
In the center, a single very clear friendly yogurt tub and spoon icon: squat gently tapered cream tub, thick smooth dark chocolate brown outlines, small rounded rim and base, a simple soft creamy yogurt swirl visible at its open top. One dark chocolate brown spoon tilted diagonally out of the top right. Put the Happy Spoon face from image 1 on the front of the tub: two chunky dark brown oval OO eyes and the same broad curved blue smile. Keep this character face simple and faithful in shape, no extra facial features. Make the central tub large, balanced and readable, occupying about 54% of canvas width including spoon. Bold rounded silhouettes, very restrained soft shading, crisp edges, flat editorial illustration with warm playful personality, premium friendly food branding.
No typography at all, no flavor names, no words, no tiny label print, no product photography, no ingredient collage, no starburst badges, no Instagram interface, no watermark, no competitor elements. Everything centered and uncluttered. The image should look like a coordinated sibling to the reference avatar, specifically communicating yogurt flavors through the tub and spoon. Opaque cream background, square deliverable.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one square Instagram Highlight cover for Happy Spoon's flavors, 1080x1080. This is an alternative design rooted directly in the existing packaging brand.
Reference 1 is the exact approved Happy Spoon wordmark. Preserve its distinctive chunky, irregular rounded letterforms, stacked two-line arrangement, chocolate brown letters and curved smile. Reference 2 is the brand palette/social avatar; use its five colors, not its face. Reference 3 is Chocolate Fudge packaging, used for the flowing ribbon visual language only.
Design: warm cream center with the HAPPY SPOON wordmark large and centered, dark rich chocolate brown lettering, bright blue curved smile beneath it. Lettering should be the main visual, comfortably legible when the whole cover is reduced to a tiny circular thumbnail. Around it, create five broad, smooth, flowing curved bands that sweep around the outer perimeter like the swoosh ribbons on the packaging: coral red #ef4c3c, bright blue #1497ec, golden caramel #f39c1e, mint green #4fc690, purple #8740cf. Make them feel like soft luscious folds of colored paper/satin with only very subtle depth, bold shapes and clean edges. The bands form a playful swirling circular frame surrounding a large clean cream center, rather than straight pie wedges or rainbow stripes. All five colors visible and balanced. Keep central brand artwork inside the central 65% diameter so it remains intact in a circular crop. Fill the square corners with the continuing colorful flowing bands.
No cartoon tub, no mascot face, no eyes other than the letters of the supplied wordmark, no products, no decorative food, no generic substitute font. No extra text, no 'flavors' label, no slogan, no border outside the composition, no watermark. The only text is HAPPY SPOON in its exact recognizable style. Premium punchy friendly food-brand graphic. One finished square image, not a mockup or multiple options.
